escalations.why: risk.Drawdown declares only ticker, depth, peak_date, but RISK-05 requires the trough date too, and TC-08 checks it: tests/fixtures/risk/TC-08/expected.json has trough_date for every ticker and says dates must match exactly. The frozen type can't express trough_date, so TC-08 can't be tested as written. Proposed change: add trough_date: str to Drawdown and to tests/contracts/risk.Drawdown/sample.json.

M1-T13 Writes names tests/contracts/test_risk_contracts.py, but scripts/check.sh protected lists it as frozen (CR-09), so path_guard blocks the edit and the protected-diff check would fail it too. Its test_drawdown_rejects_a_positive_depth builds Drawdown(ticker, depth, peak_date) without trough_date, so it raises TypeError and the gate fails. Re-freezing Drawdown with a required trough_date needs that call to pass trough_date='2024-01-03'. Ideally the file also gets a no-fall sample test (tests/contracts/risk.Drawdown/no_fall.json, already written) and trough_date in the Report key check. The rest is done in the worktree: types, drawdown spine, report row, samples, unit and smoke tests. Gate otherwise green (119 passed).
